note: Payouts build (contracts/near-vault, cargo feature `payouts`, config().version 1.1.0). Same schema and runner conventions as vault-conformance.json, which is NOT edited; this file is run against the Rust payouts build (src/conformance_pay.rs) and src/vault-model.js (tests/vault-pay-conformance.test.js). `accounts` maps every role to the account id both sides use. Do not edit to make an implementation pass.

payouts.token_total: { tokenRole: n }  token_usage(token).total_spent (current epoch; also for a disallowed token)
payouts.token_period: { tokenRole: n }  period spend EFFECTIVE at the step time t (0 when the stored period index is not the current one)
payouts.token_sent: { tokenRole: { toRole: n } }  cumulative token amount the vault transferred out, net of failed transfers (read from the ft_transfer receipts)

opArgs.pay: { token, to, amount, memo? | memo_len (n x "x") | memo_repeat [str, n] }
opArgs.on_paid: { failed, epoch, period_index, token, to, amount } called by the vault itself (private callback)

scenarios.name: pay_owner_only_gating
scenarios.description: allow_token / disallow_token / allow_payee / disallow_payee / withdraw_token are owner-only (Unauthorized first, nothing changes); pay is for the bound agent only (owner, other, newOwner and a payee are refused)

scenarios.name: pay_error_order_table
scenarios.description: NoMandate > Unauthorized > Paused > MandateInactive > TokenNotAllowed > PayeeNotAllowed > BadAmount > PerPayCap > PeriodCap > TotalCap > BadMemo > InsufficientBalance (each rule shown with every later rule also violated)

scenarios.name: pay_caps_per_pay_period_total
scenarios.description: per-pay cap, period cap (exact boundary, exact rollover at start+k*period_secs), total cap (exact), two tokens independent

scenarios.name: pay_allowlists_enforced
scenarios.description: the agent can only pay a listed payee from a listed token: owner, agent, other, the vault and a token account as payee, and an unlisted token / the owner / the vault / a payee as token, are all refused; disallow closes the door at once

scenarios.name: pay_allow_token_bounds
scenarios.description: allow_token: 0 < per_pay <= period <= total, not the vault / system / zero account, at most 8 tokens (update still works), a token is never a payee; update keeps usage

scenarios.name: pay_allow_payee_bounds
scenarios.description: allow_payee: not the vault / system / zero account / an allowed token, at most 64 payees, re-allowing is an idempotent no-op even when full

scenarios.name: pay_usage_survives_allowlist_changes_and_resets_on_new_mandate
scenarios.description: re-allow, update and disallow-then-allow never reset token usage; set_mandate resets every token (epoch) but keeps allowlists and caps

scenarios.name: pay_blocked_by_pause_revoke_expiry_withdraw_token_still_works
scenarios.description: pause, revoke and expiry (exclusive: active while now < expires_at) block pay; withdraw_token keeps working in all of them, also for a token that is no longer (or never was) allowed

scenarios.name: pay_withdraw_token_rules
scenarios.description: withdraw_token: owner only, amount > 0, never the vault / system / zero account as token (BadToken before BadAmount), works with no mandate at all, pays the current owner, a failed-transfer callback only reports

scenarios.name: pay_failed_transfer_reverses_in_same_epoch
scenarios.description: a failed ft_transfer reverses the optimistic charge (total and period) in the same epoch; the whole budget is usable again

scenarios.name: pay_successful_transfer_keeps_the_charge
scenarios.description: a successful ft_transfer leaves the charge; a callback for a token that never had a charge changes nothing

scenarios.name: pay_failed_transfer_after_mandate_replacement_is_report_only
scenarios.description: a late failure of an old-epoch transfer must not touch the new epoch counters (also a wrongly-stamped reversal finds a stale record and changes nothing)

scenarios.name: pay_failed_transfer_after_period_rollover_reverses_total_only
scenarios.description: after a period rollover the old period is not re-credited but the total is; the current period reverses with its own index

scenarios.name: pay_failed_transfer_replay_saturates
scenarios.description: a replayed failure callback can never underflow the counters

scenarios.name: pay_failed_transfer_reverses_for_a_disallowed_token
scenarios.description: a reversal also works after the token was disallowed and never touches another token

scenarios.name: pay_memo_limit_is_128_bytes
scenarios.description: memo: 128 bytes ok, 129 BadMemo; bytes not characters; empty and absent memo ok

scenarios.name: pay_preview_parity_sweep
scenarios.description: preview_pay returns exactly the code the real pay hits (as the bound agent) across fresh / no token / no payee / ok / period full / paused / next period / total full / revoked / new epoch / expired; both sides also check parity on every pay step

scenarios.name: pay_and_draw_budgets_are_independent
scenarios.description: a token payment never touches the NEAR budget and a NEAR draw never touches token usage

scenarios.name: pay_needs_spendable_near_for_the_ft_transfer_deposit
scenarios.description: pay and withdraw_token attach 1 yoctoNEAR: with no spendable NEAR they fail InsufficientBalance (after every other rule), and work once the vault has some
